method.primary: One variant per process; 4 matched pairs per runtime/mode; PO/OP/PO/OP order. 600ms warmup, nine >=160ms rounds; process median is sample; median of paired reductions reported. All CPU serial. No samples removed.
method.repetition: Two independent matched pairs (PO then OP) per runtime/N. Parse included for selector repetition. For getter repetition parse/enumeration excluded, fresh elements once then N five-key batches timed together.
method.memory: Node, five matched fresh-process launches per cell/variant, heapUsed+external delta after two GCs before/after, documents and query arrays retained. Not RSS or peak. Getter cell reads each key on each element, no query arrays beyond enumeration retained.
method.fingerprints: All independent launch fingerprints match by workload across P/O and runtimes. Untimed separate documents.
method.split: G keeps only public getter pair path; S keeps only selector pair path. Exploratory, 2 launches/cell; no matched endpoint contemporaneous control, not primary evidence.
